text:
alec: Heads up — noticed prefix cache hit rate dropped ~18% in prod after last night's runtime rollout. KV miss spikes on many recurring prompts.

maya: same. Timeline: rolled scheduler tweak (group-by-seqlen buckets) + quant-kernel v2. Could be batch ordering or key derivation change.

sasha: perfbot metrics: warmup_hit_rate 7d: 89% -> 71%. kv_key_mismatch_count spiked x3. Quick log excerpt: 
```
[2026-03-15T02:14:07Z] req_id=abc123 cache_key=pf_8f4a... hit=false reason=key_mismatch
[2026-03-15T02:14:07Z] req_id=def456 cache_key=pf_8f4a... hit=false reason=kv_layout_mismatch
```

jordan: can we reproduce locally with the new scheduler + model clone? I'll run a small harness with common prompt corpus.

alec: tried a repro on staging: when scheduler groups batches differently, the prefix cache keys include a padded-token fingerprint that depends on batch order. If padding/truncation happens after kernel selection, keys diverge.

maya: that matches my quick diff of keygen: we serialize (model_id, seq_len, pad_mask, tok_seed) in that order. pad_mask currently produced from post-scheduler tensor layout.

sasha: actionables: 1) rollback scheduler flag on prod (ops-bot?) 2) add deterministic canonicalization for pad_mask in keygen 3) add unit test for batch-order invariance 4) run full perf regression suite against quant-kernel v2.

ops-bot: rollback flag applied to cluster-gamma at 02:25 UTC (flag: scheduler_v2=false).

perfbot: post-rollback warmup_hit_rate back to 88% within 10m. Miss spike subsided.

jordan: I'll open PERF-678 with repro steps and patch. Short term mitigation is feature-flag, long term is canonical key and move pad-normalization earlier in the pipeline.

alec: also add a tracing metric for "key_derivation_version" per request so future rollouts show key drift early.

maya: good. I'll prep the PR to canonicalize keys + small perf test (microbench for keygen overhead). ETA EOD.

sasha: leaving a note: this is subtle — kernel scheduling can change tensor layouts that upstream code assumes stable. Add rollout checklist item to run prefix-cache smoke before global rollout.

alec: thanks — tracking in PERF-678 and INC-4721. ping if you need help with the perf harness. :thumbsup:
